tool_schemas.name: list-pods
tool_schemas.description: Lists your Pods (GPU compute instances) and returns a paginated result set filtered by status, template_id, container_registry_auth_id, provider_region, gpu_type, and exact name, ordered by sort_by/sort_order; pagination uses limit and a cursor returned from a previous response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any filter or pagination parameter is invalid (including enum values, ID formats, or limit outside 1–100). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not authenticated and FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the account/workspace that owns the Pods.

container_registry_auth_id.description: Filter pods by container registry auth id.

limit.description: Maximum number of pods to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous list response.

tool_schemas.name: get-pod
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single Pod by pod_id and returns its current configuration and lifecycle status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pod_id does not match the required format. Raises NOT_FOUND if the Pod does not exist or is not accessible to you, plus UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient permissions.

tool_schemas.name: create-pod
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Pod and returns the created Pod resource; you may base it on a template_id and optionally reference container_registry_auth_id for private image pulls, and desired_status controls whether it comes up running or stopped. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields (including ID formats, gpu_count < 0, vcpu_count < 1, negative sizing, or unsupported desired_status) and NOT_FOUND if template_id or container_registry_auth_id refers to a resource you cannot access or that does not exist. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when your account cannot allocate the requested capacity and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient permissions.

template_id.description: Optional template id to base configuration on.

container_registry_auth_id.description: Optional container registry auth id for pulling private images.

expose_http.description: Whether to expose an HTTP service.

env.description: Environment variables map for the container.

tool_schemas.name: update-pod
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing Pod’s mutable configuration fields and returns the updated Pod resource. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid updates (including ID formats, resource sizing constraints, or unsupported desired_status) and NOT_FOUND if the Pod, template_id, or container_registry_auth_id does not exist or is not accessible to you. Raises CONFLICT if the Pod cannot be updated in its current lifecycle state (for example while provisioning/starting/stopping) and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient permissions.

template_id.description: Template id to base configuration on.

container_registry_auth_id.description: Container registry auth id for pulling private images.

expose_http.description: Whether to expose an HTTP service.

env.description: Environment variables map for the container.

tool_schemas.name: start-pod
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a Pod to the running state and returns the Pod with its updated lifecycle status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pod_id is malformed and NOT_FOUND if the Pod does not exist or is not accessible to you. Raises CONFLICT if the Pod is not in a startable state (e.g., already running, provisioning, stopping, or deleted) and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack permission.

tool_schemas.name: stop-pod
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a Pod to the stopped state and returns the Pod with its updated lifecycle status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pod_id is malformed and NOT_FOUND if the Pod does not exist or is not accessible to you. Raises CONFLICT if the Pod is not in a stoppable state (e.g., already stopped, provisioning, starting, or deleted) and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack permission.

tool_schemas.name: delete-pod
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a Pod and returns the deleted Pod (or deletion result) once the deletion request is accepted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pod_id is malformed and NOT_FOUND if the Pod does not exist or is not accessible to you. Raises CONFLICT if the Pod cannot be deleted due to its current state or because it has attachments/dependencies that must be detached first, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack permission.

tool_schemas.name: list-endpoints
tool_schemas.description: Lists your Endpoints (serverless/inference deployments) and returns a paginated result set filtered by status, template_id, container_registry_auth_id, gpu_type, auth_mode, and exact name, ordered by sort_by/sort_order; pagination uses limit and a cursor returned from a previous response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any filter or pagination parameter is invalid (including enum values, ID formats, or limit outside 1–100). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not authenticated and FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the account/workspace that owns the Endpoints.

container_registry_auth_id.description: Filter endpoints by container registry auth id.

limit.description: Maximum number of endpoints to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous list response.

tool_schemas.name: get-endpoint
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single Endpoint by endpoint_id and returns its current configuration and deployment status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if endpoint_id does not match the required format. Raises NOT_FOUND if the Endpoint does not exist or is not accessible to you, plus UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient permissions.

endpoint_id.description: The endpoint ID to retrieve (e.g., endp_01H8KJ2Y9QZ7T3V6W1X5N0ABCD).

tool_schemas.name: create-endpoint
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Endpoint and returns the created Endpoint resource, optionally based on template_id and optionally using container_registry_auth_id to pull a private image; scaling and auth_mode control runtime behavior. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields (including ID formats, negative worker/timeout values, max_workers < min_workers, or unsupported auth_mode) and NOT_FOUND if template_id or container_registry_auth_id refers to a resource you cannot access or that does not exist. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when your account cannot allocate the requested capacity and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient permissions.

template_id.description: Template ID to base this endpoint on.

container_registry_auth_id.description: Container registry auth credential ID for pulling private images.

image.description: Container image reference to deploy (e.g., repo/image:tag).

gpu_type.description: GPU type/sku identifier to request for workers.

min_workers.description: Minimum number of warm workers to keep running.

max_workers.description: Maximum number of workers allowed to scale up to.

idle_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds of idleness before scaling workers down.

env.description: Environment variables for the runtime (key/value map).

auth_mode.description: Authentication mode for invoking the endpoint.

request_schema.description: JSON schema-like object describing the expected request payload.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def create_endpoint(name, template_id=None, container_registry_auth_id=None, image=None, gpu_type=None, min_workers=None, max_workers=None, idle_timeout_seconds=None, env=None, auth_mode=None, request_schema=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, random, string
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0442000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0442000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    status = "success"

    def _log(status_val, resource_id=None, err=None):
        latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        row = {
            "id": "req_" + datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f"),
            "endpoint": "create-endpoint",
            "status": status_val,
            "latency_ms": latency_ms,
            "timestamp": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
        }
        if resource_id:
            row["resource_id"] = resource_id
        if err:
            row["error"] = err
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            logs = []
        logs.append(row)
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    def _gen_id(prefix):
        # 26 chars A-Z0-9
        alphabet = string.ascii_uppercase + string.digits
        return prefix + "_" + "".join(random.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(26))

    def _meta_endpoint(ep):
        ep_out = dict(ep)
        for k in list(ep_out.keys()):
            if "secret" in k or "cipher" in k or "token" in k:
                ep_out.pop(k, None)
        return ep_out

    try:
        # Validate required
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
            status = "error"
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "name is required and must be a non-empty string", field="name")
            _log(status, err=e["error"])
            return e
        name = name.strip()

        if template_id is not None:
            if not isinstance(template_id, str) or not re.match(r"^tmpl_[0-9A-Z]{26}$", template_id):
                status = "error"
                e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "template_id must match pattern ^tmpl_[0-9A-Z]{26}$", field="template_id")
                _log(status, err=e["error"])
                return e

        if container_registry_auth_id is not None:
            if not isinstance(container_registry_auth_id, str) or not re.match(r"^cra_[0-9A-Z]{26}$", container_registry_auth_id):
                status = "error"
                e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "container_registry_auth_id must match pattern ^cra_[0-9A-Z]{26}$", field="container_registry_auth_id")
                _log(status, err=e["error"])
                return e

        if image is not None and not isinstance(image, str):
            status = "error"
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "image must be a string", field="image")
            _log(status, err=e["error"])
            return e

        if gpu_type is not None and not isinstance(gpu_type, str):
            status = "error"
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "gpu_type must be a string", field="gpu_type")
            _log(status, err=e["error"])
            return e

        if min_workers is None:
            min_workers = 0
        if max_workers is None:
            max_workers = 0

        if not isinstance(min_workers, int) or min_workers < 0 or min_workers > 1000:
            status = "error"
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "min_workers must be an integer between 0 and 1000", field="min_workers")
            _log(status, err=e["error"])
            return e
        if not isinstance(max_workers, int) or max_workers < 0 or max_workers > 1000:
            status = "error"
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "max_workers must be an integer between 0 and 1000", field="max_workers")
            _log(status, err=e["error"])
            return e
        if max_workers < min_workers:
            status = "error"
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "max_workers must be >= min_workers", field="max_workers")
            _log(status, err=e["error"])
            return e

        if idle_timeout_seconds is not None:
            if not isinstance(idle_timeout_seconds, int) or idle_timeout_seconds < 0 or idle_timeout_seconds > 86400:
                status = "error"
                e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "idle_timeout_seconds must be an integer between 0 and 86400", field="idle_timeout_seconds")
                _log(status, err=e["error"])
                return e

        if env is not None and not isinstance(env, dict):
            status = "error"
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "env must be an object (map)", field="env")
            _log(status, err=e["error"])
            return e

        if request_schema is not None and not isinstance(request_schema, dict):
            status = "error"
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "request_schema must be an object", field="request_schema")
            _log(status, err=e["error"])
            return e

        if auth_mode is None:
            auth_mode = "none"
        if not isinstance(auth_mode, str) or auth_mode not in ("none", "api_key"):
            status = "error"
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "auth_mode must be one of: none, api_key", field="auth_mode")
            _log(status, err=e["error"])
            return e

        endpoints = _load("endpoints.json")
        if not isinstance(endpoints, list):
            endpoints = []

        # Uniqueness: unique(name) where deleted_at is null
        if any(isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("deleted_at") is None and r.get("name") == name for r in endpoints):
            status = "error"
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "An endpoint with this name already exists", field="name")
            _log(status, err=e["error"])
            return e

        templates = _load("templates.json")
        if not isinstance(templates, list):
            templates = []

        chosen_template = None
        if template_id is not None:
            chosen_template = next((t for t in templates if isinstance(t, dict) and t.get("id") == template_id and t.get("deleted_at") is None), None)
            if not chosen_template:
                status = "error"
                e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Template not found", template_id=template_id)
                _log(status, err=e["error"])
                return e

        cras = _load("container_registry_auths.json")
        if not isinstance(cras, list):
            cras = []
        if container_registry_auth_id is not None:
            cra = next((c for c in cras if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("id") == container_registry_auth_id and c.get("deleted_at") is None and c.get("status") in ("active", "revoked")), None)
            if not cra:
                status = "error"
                e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Container registry auth not found", container_registry_auth_id=container_registry_auth_id)
                _log(status, err=e["error"])
                return e
            if cra.get("status") == "deleted" or cra.get("deleted_at") is not None:
                status = "error"
                e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Container registry auth not found", container_registry_auth_id=container_registry_auth_id)
                _log(status, err=e["error"])
                return e

        # Apply template defaults when explicit fields absent (for endpoints we only have default_image/default_env/default_gpu_type)
        if chosen_template is not None:
            if image is None:
                image = chosen_template.get("default_image")
            if env is None and chosen_template.get("default_env") is not None:
                if isinstance(chosen_template.get("default_env"), dict):
                    env = dict(chosen_template.get("default_env"))
            if gpu_type is None and chosen_template.get("default_gpu_type") is not None:
                gpu_type = chosen_template.get("default_gpu_type")

        if image is None or not isinstance(image, str) or not image.strip():
            status = "error"
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "image is required (or must be provided by template) and must be a non-empty string", field="image")
            _log(status, err=e["error"])
            return e
        image = image.strip()

        now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"
        new_id = _gen_id("endp")
        # Ensure uniqueness of id in store
        while any(isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("id") == new_id for r in endpoints):
            new_id = _gen_id("endp")

        ep = {
            "id": new_id,
            "name": name,
            "template_id": template_id,
            "container_registry_auth_id": container_registry_auth_id,
            "image": image,
            "gpu_type": gpu_type,
            "min_workers": min_workers,
            "max_workers": max_workers,
            "idle_timeout_seconds": idle_timeout_seconds,
            "env": env,
            "status": "deploying",
            "url": None,
            "auth_mode": auth_mode,
            "request_schema": request_schema,
            "deleted_at": None,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }

        # Simulate deployment completion: transition deploying -> active and set url
        ep["status"] = "active"
        ep["url"] = "https://endpoints.runpod.local/" + new_id

        endpoints.append(ep)
        _save("endpoints.json", endpoints)

        _log(status, resource_id=new_id)
        return {"endpoint": _meta_endpoint(ep)}
    except Exception as ex:
        status = "error"
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Unexpected error", detail=str(ex))
        _log(status, err=e["error"])
        return e

tool_schemas.name: update-endpoint
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing Endpoint’s configuration (for example name, template/image, scaling bounds, runtime env, and auth mode) and returns the updated Endpoint record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any field fails schema constraints (including ID formats, non-negative worker/timeouts, or invalid auth_mode) or if min_workers exceeds max_workers; raises NOT_FOUND if endpoint_id does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you do not own the Endpoint and CONFLICT if the referenced template_id or container_registry_auth_id cannot be used by you or is incompatible with the Endpoint’s configuration.

template_id.description: Template ID to base this endpoint on.

container_registry_auth_id.description: Container registry auth credential ID for pulling private images.

image.description: Container image reference to deploy (e.g., repo/image:tag).

gpu_type.description: GPU type/sku identifier to request for workers.

min_workers.description: Minimum number of warm workers to keep running.

max_workers.description: Maximum number of workers allowed to scale up to.

idle_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds of idleness before scaling workers down.

env.description: Environment variables for the runtime (key/value map).

auth_mode.description: Authentication mode for invoking the endpoint.

request_schema.description: JSON schema-like object describing the expected request payload.

tool_schemas.name: delete-endpoint
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes an Endpoint and returns the deleted Endpoint record (marked deleted) so it no longer accepts new configuration changes or invocations. Raises NOT_FOUND if endpoint_id does not exist and UNAUTHORIZED if you do not own the Endpoint. Raises CONFLICT if the Endpoint cannot be deleted due to an in-progress operation or state that refuses deletion.

endpoint_id.description: The endpoint ID to delete (soft delete).

tool_schemas.name: list-templates
tool_schemas.description: Lists Templates visible to your account, optionally filtered by kind and status, and returns a page of results ordered by the requested sort field and direction. Results are cursor-paginated: we return up to limit items and a next cursor when more results are available; pass cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter/sort values or out-of-range limit, and UNAUTHORIZED if you are not authenticated.

limit.description: Maximum number of templates to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-template
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single Template by template_id and returns the full Template record. Raises NOT_FOUND if the template_id does not exist and UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have access to that Template. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if template_id does not match the required format.

template_id.description: The template ID to retrieve (e.g., tmpl_01H8KJ2Y9QZ7T3V6W1X5N0ABCD).

tool_schemas.name: create-template
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Template with the provided defaults (image/env/GPU/disk/ports) and returns the created Template record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, kind/status are invalid, numeric defaults are negative, or any default_ports value is outside 1–65535. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not authenticated and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you have reached your Template limit.

description.description: Description of what this template is for.

default_image.description: Default container image to use when instantiating from this template.

default_env.description: Default environment variables to apply (key/value map).

default_gpu_count.description: Default number of GPUs to request.

default_ports.description: Default ports to expose for pods/endpoints created from this template.

tool_schemas.name: update-template
tool_schemas.description: Updates fields on an existing Template and returns the updated Template record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any supplied field is invalid (including ID format, negative numeric defaults, or invalid port numbers) and UNAUTHORIZED if you do not own the Template. Raises NOT_FOUND if template_id does not exist and CONFLICT if the Template is deleted and therefore cannot be modified.

description.description: Description of what this template is for.

default_image.description: Default container image to use when instantiating from this template.

default_env.description: Default environment variables to apply (key/value map).

default_gpu_count.description: Default number of GPUs to request.

default_ports.description: Default ports to expose for pods/endpoints created from this template.

tool_schemas.name: delete-template
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a Template and returns the deleted Template record (marked deleted); by default we enforce referential integrity so templates referenced by Pods/Endpoints cannot be removed. Raises NOT_FOUND if template_id does not exist and UNAUTHORIZED if you do not own the Template. Raises CONFLICT if force is false and the Template is still referenced, or if the Template is already deleted.

template_id.description: ID of the template to delete.

force.description: If true, delete even if referenced by pods/endpoints; otherwise enforce referential integrity.

tool_schemas.name: list-network-volumes
tool_schemas.description: Lists Network Volumes in your account, optionally filtered by region, status, and exact name, and returns a cursor-paginated page of results sorted by the requested field and direction. Results are cursor-paginated: we return up to limit items and a next cursor when more results are available; pass cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid status/sort values or out-of-range limit, and UNAUTHORIZED if you are not authenticated.

limit.description: Maximum number of volumes to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-network-volume
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single Network Volume by volume_id and returns the Volume record including its current lifecycle status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if volume_id does not match the required format and NOT_FOUND if no such volume exists. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have access to the volume.

volume_id.description: ID of the network volume to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: create-network-volume
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Network Volume in the specified region with the requested size and filesystem and returns the created Volume record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, filesystem is not one of ext4/xfs, or size_gb is invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED if you are not authenticated. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you have reached your volume limits and CONFLICT if the requested region cannot accept the create request.

region.description: Region in which to create the volume.

filesystem.description: Filesystem to create on the volume.

tool_schemas.name: update-network-volume
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable properties of a Network Volume by volume_id (name, requested size_gb, and/or filesystem) and returns the updated volume record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if volume_id does not match the required format, if filesystem is not one of the allowed values, or if size_gb is not a valid number; raises NOT_FOUND if the volume_id does not exist or is not visible to your account; raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to modify the volume. Raises CONFLICT if the requested change is not allowed in the volume’s current state (for example, attempting to change filesystem or resize while the volume is attached/in use).

volume_id.description: ID of the network volume to update.

size_gb.description: New requested volume size in GB.

filesystem.description: New filesystem type for the volume.

tool_schemas.name: delete-network-volume
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a Network Volume identified by volume_id and returns a confirmation of deletion. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if volume_id is malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the volume does not exist or is not visible to your account; raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to delete it. Raises CONFLICT if the volume is mounted/attached or otherwise in use and force is not set, or if deletion is refused due to dependency constraints that require detaching first.

volume_id.description: ID of the network volume to delete.

force.description: If true, delete even if mounted/in use; otherwise require it to be detachable.

tool_schemas.name: list-container-registry-auths
tool_schemas.description: Lists container registry auth credentials for your account and returns a paged result set filtered/sorted by the provided fields; pagination uses limit and an opaque cursor, and the response includes the next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range, if status/credential_type/sort_by/sort_order are not allowed values, or if cursor is invalid; raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to list credentials. May raise QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request rate or account limits for listing are exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of credentials to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-container-registry-auth
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single container registry auth credential by container_registry_auth_id and returns its metadata (the secret is never returned in plaintext). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the ID format is invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the credential does not exist or is not visible to your account; raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to access it. May raise GONE if the credential is in a deleted state and no longer retrievable.

container_registry_auth_id.description: ID of the container registry auth credential to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: create-container-registry-auth
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new container registry auth credential (name, registry, credential_type, and secret) and returns the created credential metadata; the secret is stored encrypted and is not returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, if credential_type is not supported, or if registry/secret values fail validation; raises FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to create credentials. Raises CONFLICT if a credential with the same unique identity (such as name within your account) already exists, and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you have reached the maximum number of stored credentials.

name.description: Human-readable name for this container registry credential.

registry.description: Container registry hostname/URL this credential applies to (e.g., index.docker.io, ghcr.io).

username.description: Username to authenticate to the registry (if applicable for the credential type).

credential_type.description: Type of secret being provided for registry authentication.

secret.description: Raw secret material to store (password/token/json key); will be encrypted and not returned in plaintext.

tool_schemas.name: delete-container-registry-auth
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a container registry auth credential by container_registry_auth_id and returns a confirmation of deletion. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the ID format is invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the credential does not exist or is not visible to your account; raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to delete it. Raises CONFLICT if the credential is still referenced by pods/endpoints and force is not set, or if deletion is blocked to preserve referential integrity.

container_registry_auth_id.description: ID of the container registry auth credential to delete.

force.description: If true, delete even if referenced by pods/endpoints; otherwise deletion is blocked to preserve referential integrity.

metadata.name: RunPod
metadata.description: This backend stores RunPod customer resources for GPU compute: Pods (compute instances), Endpoints (serverless/inference deployments), reusable Templates, attachable Network Volumes, and Container Registry Auth credentials used to pull private images. Core workflows are CRUD on these resources plus
